# -- output: paging ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
new -14
pc
set act 0
set lines 3
page line 1\n\rline 2\n\rline 3\n\rline 4\n\rline 5\n\rline 6\n\rline 7\n\rline 8\n\r
flush 0
show
flush 0
show \s
flush 0
show stop
flush 0
set lines 0
page line 1\n\rline 2\n\rline 3\n\rline 4\n\rline 5\n\rline 6\n\rline 7\n\rline 8\n\r
flush 0
set lines 4
page short\n\r
flush 0

# -- act(): characters 4 (Alice) and 5 (Bob) are players, 6 is a mob; objects 0 and 1 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
new -14
pc
str name Alice
set sex 2
new -14
pc
str name Bob
set sex 1
npc a goblin
obj 0 a shiny sword
obj 32 an invisible ring
use 4
act TO_ROOM 4 - - $n smiles.
use 5
flush 0
use 4
flush 0
act TO_CHAR 4 - - You smile at $N.
flush 0
act TO_VICT 4 - 5 $n pokes $N: $e $m $s, $E $M $S.
use 5
flush 0
use 4
act TO_NOTVICT 4 - 5 $n pokes $N.
use 5
flush 0
use 4
act TO_ROOM 4 0 - $n drops $p.
act TO_ROOM 4 1 - $n drops $p.
use 5
flush 0
use 4
actt TO_ROOM 4 hello - $n says '$t'.
actt TO_ROOM 4 - north\seast $n opens the $d.
actt TO_ROOM 4 - - $n opens the $d.
actt TO_ROOM 4 - \s $n opens the $d.
act TO_ROOM 4 - - {Rlower$n{x and $q.
act TO_ROOM 6 - - $n grunts.
use 5
flush 0
use 4
set affected_by 2
act TO_ROOM 4 - - $n is invisible.
use 5
flush 0
set affected_by 8
use 4
act TO_ROOM 4 - - $n is seen now.
use 5
flush 0
set affected_by 0
room 0 2 0
sun 0
use 4
act TO_ROOM 4 0 - In the dark, $n drops $p.
use 5
flush 0
set position 4
use 4
act TO_ROOM 4 - - $n is ignored by sleepers.
use 5
flush 0
